children: Curtiss-Wright authorized an additional $510 million in share repurchases, bringing total buyback capacity to $700 million and launching a $100 million 10b5-1 plan.
Board approved an extra $510M repurchase authorization; total available authorization is $700M.
Company implemented a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan to buy $100M of shares ratably through Oct 30, 2026.
Repurchases may be executed via open market, ASR, negotiated blocks, 10b5-1 plans or other methods.
Quarterly dividend declared at $0.26 per share, payable Oct 9, 2026 to holders of record Sept 25, 2026.
After the current 10b5-1 plan, expected remaining authorization will be $600M for future repurchases.
